snippet.title: The Array Methods Song
snippet.description:
A little song to help remember JavaScript array methods (array.map, array.filter, and array.reduce by)

Lyrics:

When you don’t know 
With which method to go
You’ve got map reduce and filter
You can use them all together 

You can Use a map
When you want all your values back,
With a little bit of a transform,
You’ll return them as a pack,

If you’ve got a few,
But only some vals pass as true,
You’ll want to use a filter,
To return the ones that do.

And finally reduce,
Is the perfect thing to use,
If you want a single output,
Like a recipe for juice.


When you don’t know 
With which method to go
Remember map reduce and filter
You can use them all together 
Right Now

snippet.title: Top 3 Underrated Cities for Digital Nomads and Remote Workers
snippet.description:
Remote work (which is also called digital nomading by some) has never been more popular! And with the option to go anywhere, where do you decide to go?! In this video, I talk about my 3 favorite spots which I think are pretty underrated. 

I looked at:
    - Good wifi (the most important thing!)
    - Places to work (outside of your hotel or AirBnb)
    - Things to do & culture (inside and outside of town)
    - Affordability (cost of living and if you get the most bang for your buck)

This is just my opinion! There are so many beautiful places out there to explore and I hope to explore them soon! If you're a digital nomad or remote worker, let me know what your favorite underrated places are in the comments!

This video was done in partnership with the city of Malmo -- all opinions are my own. #makeitmalmö #malmotown #investinskåne

snippet.title: All About Ideating: A Simple Method For Side Project, Video, Talk, and Blog Post Ideas
snippet.description:
Sometimes we want to build things to learn a technology or just for fun, but coming up with ideas can be a challenge. In this video, I walk you through a simple way that I use list making to come up with project ideas. It's a short video but I hope you like it. This can work for side projects, conference talks, youtube video ideas, podcast ideas, blog post ideas, side hustles, businesses, crafts, gifts, activities to do, or really just about anything. If you want to learn a task or skill, thinking about the convergence of that technique with your existing interests is a great way to go.

snippet.title: Startup Stock Options & Equity 101 for Tech Employees
snippet.description:
How does startup equity and startup stock options work for employees? What does it mean when a private company offers you stock options as a part of your employee package? This video starts to dive into some of those things!

I go over potential company exits, what it means if a company IPO’s, what it means to buy or sell options, and how to decide if buying your company’s stock is right for you.

Hopefully this video will help you get a basic understanding of how the system works so you can make better financial decisions!

SOME THINGS TO NOTE: Premium Stock is also called Preferred stock, and the time you need to hold your stock post-IPO is also called the “lock-up” period.
